blocking_findings.finding: The mutable cumulative gradient ndarray is stored by reference in every prefix record. JSON serialization occurs after all prefixes, so each active-load prefix stores the final-prefix gradient. Four earlier active-prefix records contradict their own charge-moment predictions and reported relative closure.

Snapshot g at record construction, produce a separately named rerun and compact receipt, and add a regression that checks serialized vectors across multiple prefixes. Independently re-review the correction and revised evidence before acceptance.

findings.evidence: Reconstructed public_queries(config) exactly matches saved t0_a0 amplitudes, shape and center. Both scripts discard stream truth output; model residual uses observed quantized voltage obs[:,3] and public sigma obs[:,4]. Cell truth is used only inside deterministic stimulus generation. This is a simulated measured stream, not real hardware data.

findings.claim: H-only defect and independent native C chain
findings.evidence: Amplitude columns 9/10 isolate forced/free H and B contributions. Approximate whitened columns are unwhitened with sigma; native J is chained with chart_amplitude_jacobian and D=F@D across chunks. At fixed k, q maps simultaneously into log Q and both bare gamma rows, canceling artificial rate dependence. x=end preserves physical chronology and source/order checks are active.

One QR factor retains [m,-m*A,reference residual,e]/sigma. Separate least-squares solves use the same full design and measured residual, giving unconstrained z0/q shifts with fixed nuisance amplitudes/shapes and no prior. Status explicitly refuses a battery estimate. Rest reports unresolved_zero_charge_variation for every prefix. Positive-variance active fixtures have finite conditional shifts; physical support flags are diagnostic and do not turn them into full-estimator fits.

With n=3, start=21. Row-major pairs place c22 at index 8, so forced c22 column is29 and free c22 column38; width40 includes final measured residual at39. kron(p1,p1) follows native q*m+r node order. rows() advances nodal response and does not update the zero root; no repaired likelihood is trained. Direct coefficient gaps and voltage gaps are distinct quantities.

Both compact receipts are byte-identical to their corresponding local original result.json. All baseline-result identities, baseline-registration identities, and nine observation prefix hashes per control match. All 38 registered source files for each original run matched at review before the parent correction, and H1-H3/H4 proof bindings match the reviewed packets. Existing binary identities also match. All four individual proof reviews accept conditionally.

Mixed-term gap maxima, two-run endpoint products, dose/run counts and QR-shift closure agree with compact records. Original reported charge-gradient scalar closure maxima are plausible and the isolated first-prefix reproduction confirms the intended calculation, but the original serialized gradient vectors are not valid multi-prefix evidence until CTRL-R1-1 is corrected.

limits: Finite checks at one public center on three synthetic measured-stream recipes; no uniform value/derivative/interpolation bound.
The two-variable optimum is conditional and unconstrained; no nuisance marginalization, posterior normalization, coverage or point-accuracy result.

Current rest detection uses floating-point charge variance>0 rather than a general rank/conditioning certificate; acceptable only for these exactly zero rest fixtures and resolved finite active designs. Near-constant-charge extension needs explicit numerical rank treatment.
B=0 at the public center; free coefficient identity is checked separately, but the voltage witness alone does not excite the B contribution.
No new joint likelihood repair, aging/temperature extension, campaign/default promotion, SCM/NAIA/D2 proof or Cortex-M23 resource qualification.
Tables, calibration, metadata, priors, optimizers, transactions, scratch, stacks/ISR and other platform memory remain outside quoted subtotals.
